evidence.observation: The firefighter walks right and clears the first ledges with single jumps.
evidence.riff: One fixed-height jump, no double-jump: every gap is sized to exactly one hop.

evidence.observation: The HUD clock counts down from 40 seconds as play begins.
evidence.riff: The 40s limit is a value in the level JSON; it's the pressure the whole level is tuned around.

evidence.observation: Flames stick up on the climb ledges; each jump threads over fire.
evidence.riff: Fire is the obstacle, not decoration: clear it clean or take a retry.

evidence.observation: Tapping W pours water; the blocking fire shrinks full-to-half-to-gone over ~4s.
evidence.riff: One fire_height() drives both the flames and the kill zone, so they shrink together; the base stays lethal until it's fully out.

evidence.observation: With the fire out, walking into the person rescues them.
evidence.riff: Rescue is an Area2D overlap, gated so it can't fire while you're dying.

evidence.observation: A committed jump crosses the burning street gap to Building 2.
evidence.riff: A ground-level gap with fire in it: mistime it and it's a retry.

evidence.observation: The rooftop fire escape completes only after both survivors are saved.
evidence.riff: The finish needs overlap + on-floor + an all-rescued flag: both, or nothing.

evidence.observation: The run completes on the roof and can be replayed.
evidence.riff: Reaching the unlocked exit on foot is the win condition.

evidence.observation: Walking into the flame kills the firefighter, who instantly respawns at the start.
evidence.riff: No lives, no penalty screen: the state machine flips to dying, then retries.

features.reason: Documented as a 'someday' stretch goal; not built in this window.
